sources.description: The Minnesota Vikings schedule appears to lighten up this week with the low-flying Atlanta Falcons headed north. The Falcons have the third-worst passing defense in the NFL, allowing 239 yards per game through the air. The Vikings offense should be able to move the ball against a very mediocre defense.
